name: Payat sa Taas
source:
Payat sa Taas is a story told from the perspective of 16-year-old Spat who lives on a Landfill in Zenquo City. Together with his pet dog Paws, they make difficult choices in life which are extremely crucial to their survival. 

[From [url=https://zenjlle.itch.io/payat-sa-taas]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Payat sa Taas》以16岁的斯帕特为视角展开。他住在Zenquo市的一处垃圾填埋场，与宠物狗爪爪相依为命。他们必须作出艰难的人生选择，而这些选择，对生存至关重要。

[摘自[url=https://zenjlle.itch.io/payat-sa-taas]itch.io[/url]]
